import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def main():
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    mod = int(data[2])

    N = 509
    C = [[0] * (N) for _ in range(N)]
    f = [0] * (N)
    g = [0] * (N)
    dp = [[0] * (N) for _ in range(N)]
    dp2 = [[0] * (N) for _ in range(N)]

    for i in range(n + 1):
        C[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(i):
            C[i][j + 1] = (C[i - 1][j + 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % mod

    f[0] = 1
    g[0] = 0
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, i + 2):
            temp1 = (C[i - 1][j - 1] * (i + 1)) % mod
            f[i] = (f[i] + temp1 * f[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % mod
            term1 = (C[i - 1][j - 1] * (i + 1)) % mod
            term2 = (f[j - 1] * g[i - j] + g[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % mod
            g[i] = (g[i] + term1 * term2) % mod
            addend = (C[i - 1][j - 1] * (((j - 1) * j // 2) + ((i - j + 1) * (i - j) // 2))) % mod
            g[i] = (g[i] + addend * f[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % mod

    n += 1
    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(m + 1):
            dp[i][j] = 0
            dp2[i][j] = 0
    dp[0][0] = 1
    dp2[0][0] = 0

    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(m + 1):
            for k in range(0, m - j + 1):
                if i + k + 1 > n:
                    continue
                c = C[j + k][j]
                val1 = (dp[i][j] * f[k]) % mod
                val2 = (dp2[i][j] * c) % mod
                val3 = (dp[i][j] * g[k]) % mod
                sum2 = (val2 + val3) % mod
                new_dp = (dp[i][j] * f[k] * c) % mod
                new_dp2 = (sum2 * c) % mod
                dp[i + k + 1][j + k] = (dp[i + k + 1][j + k] + new_dp) % mod
                dp2[i + k + 1][j + k] = (dp2[i + k + 1][j + k] + new_dp2) % mod

    print(dp2[n][m])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
